description: This file defines the CommandUsageRepository class, which provides database operations related to command usage records in the application. It includes methods for finding, inserting, updating, and deleting command usage data, and utilizes SQL query builders for database interactions.

classes.name: CommandUsageRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing command usage entries in the database, including CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Fetches a command usage record by its unique ID, including creator full name.

methods.name: findByCommandId
methods.description: Retrieves all command usage records associated with a specific command ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all command usage records from the database.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for command usage records based on criteria with optional pagination.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a base SelectQueryBuilder instance for command_usage table.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a command usage record by its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new command usage record into the database.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates a command usage record identified by its ID with new column values.

calls: MYSQLI Prepared Statement methods (prepare, bind_param, execute, get_result, fetch_assoc, fetch_all, close)
